name: Edit and save platform-aware social captions
description: Verifies a creator can review platform-specific captions, edit the Facebook caption, save it, and keep the saved version after reopening the reel.
steps: Open a saved reel in Studio
Confirm a longer caption suggestion is present
Leave and reopen the same reel
expected: The Facebook caption is editable, saves successfully, and the edited caption remains visible after reopening the reel.

name: Keep the free MP4 export workflow available
description: Verifies the browser WebM preview exposes visible progress while building and keeps the existing free MP4 export workflow available.
steps: Open a saved reel with visuals and narration
Confirm the preview button shows a percentage while rendering
Confirm a progress bar and rendering status are visible
After the WebM is ready, confirm Free Device Export is visible
Confirm Convert to MP4 is available
expected: WebM rendering exposes a 0-100 progress state and status, then the free device MP4 conversion remains available.

name: Keep scene recovery and mobile controls usable
description: Verifies the social caption panel coexists with the existing scene recovery controls on a mobile viewport.
steps: Open Studio on a mobile viewport
Confirm Scene visual source is still available
Confirm platform tabs and Save captions are visible
expected: Scene recovery remains available and the social caption editor remains usable on mobile.

name: Use the full manual script without a 90-second ceiling
description: Verifies a long manual story is imported in full and its runtime is derived from the narration rather than capped at 90 seconds.
steps: Paste a story longer than 90 seconds
Confirm Video length shows Auto — Full Script
Select the desired number of scenes
expected: The complete story is preserved, the runtime is calculated from the full narration, and no 90-second limit is applied.

name: Animate a scene image into a real video
description: Verifies a scene with a generated image can be sent to Runway and return as a persisted video visual without removing the existing free motion controls.
steps: Open a saved reel with a generated image
Click AI Video on a scene
Confirm the scene shows an AI animation processing state
Wait for the Runway task to finish
Confirm the scene visual changes from image to video
expected: The scene becomes a persisted video visual, the AI processing state clears, and the saved reel still exposes the free motion effects for image scenes.

name: Synchronize captions to an uploaded voice
description: Verifies an uploaded narration is transcribed with timed words so the caption cues follow the actual recording instead of simple word-count estimates.
steps: Open a saved reel with narration text
Confirm the dropdown arrow opens a scrollable list of available voices
Drag the voice list scrollbar up and down
Search for a voice by name or label
Select a voice and confirm it becomes the narration source
Confirm Eleven v3 — Expressive is available
Upload an MP3 or WAV voice recording
Wait for Syncing captions to finish
Confirm captions appear in time with the uploaded narration
expected: The uploaded voice remains usable and the saved caption cues use the recording's word timestamps; if transcription is unavailable, estimated timing remains available as a fallback.

name: Create and retain an Explainer source project
description: Verifies a signed-in creator can create an explainer project, upload a video source, and see the project in Explainer Studio.
steps: Confirm the project card is visible
expected: The project appears with its source filename and can be reopened.

name: Configure intelligent clip discovery
description: Verifies the creator can choose a target duration and discovery mode before analysis.
expected: The analysis workflow starts and the interface states that duration is a target rather than a blind cut.

name: Review clip opportunities on mobile
description: Verifies analyzed opportunities remain usable on mobile.
steps: Confirm a playable MP4 is produced
Confirm score, timing, rationale and Create Explainer action
expected: Each opportunity exposes a real rendered source preview plus score, timing, rationale and a clear next action.

name: Reject a non-video upload
description: Verifies invalid source files are rejected without creating an invalid project.
expected: A visible validation message asks for a video file and no invalid project is created.

name: Upload a large source with verified chunk integrity
description: Verifies a large source is uploaded in chunks with progress tied to confirmed bytes, per-chunk hashes and exact byte lengths instead of a fake timer or whole-file base64 conversion.
steps: Observe uploaded MB and percentage increase as chunks are confirmed
expected: The upload advances from confirmed bytes, reaches 100% only after finalization succeeds, and shows a completed source project without the browser needing to load the entire video into one base64 string.

name: Keep processing separate from upload completion
description: Verifies the UI does not hold the upload at 99 percent while later processing is occurring.
steps: Confirm the upload reaches 100% and shows Upload complete
expected: 100% represents completed upload only, while audio extraction, transcription and semantic analysis are shown as a separate processing stage.

name: Show honest elapsed timing during intelligent clip discovery
description: Verifies intelligent clip discovery exposes visible progress tied to its processing stages and an elapsed timer with an estimated remaining time when enough progress exists.
steps: Choose a target duration and discovery mode
Observe the processing percentage and progress bar
Observe the elapsed timer and estimated remaining time
expected: The analysis UI shows stage progress that advances with real processing milestones, an elapsed timer that advances while work is active, and an estimated remaining time without claiming a fake completion state.

name: Prepare persistent Explainer source for analysis
description: Verifies a reopened source project is prepared from persistent chunks without reconstructing the entire source video in browser memory.
steps: Confirm Find intelligent clips becomes available
expected: The original source is prepared for the analysis pipeline without asking for a re-upload or rebuilding the full source into a browser Blob.

name: Show persistent source diagnostics after reopening
description: Verifies reopening a stored source exposes chunk verification and media-provider diagnostics before analysis without requiring another upload.
steps: Confirm chunk verification counts and provider status are visible
Confirm the project states the permanent chunks remain retained
expected: The reopened project shows persistent source diagnostics, including chunk/byte verification and provider availability or failure, while keeping the stored source available without re-uploading.

name: Analyze source video directly with timed transcription
description: Verifies intelligent discovery uses the persistent source video directly for transcription and then produces source-grounded opportunities.
steps: Choose a target duration and discovery mode
expected: The original source video is transcribed directly by the speech-to-text provider and the resulting opportunities contain source-grounded timestamps.

name: Verify persistent source chunk integrity before analysis
description: Verifies an existing Explainer source is checked from persistent chunks before ReelForge treats it as valid.
steps: Confirm the source shows as verified when all chunks are intact
expected: ReelForge verifies every expected chunk, validates byte length and SHA-256 hash, checks total bytes, and validates the MKV container signature when applicable.

name: Render a real source clip preview
description: Verifies an analyzed opportunity can be rendered from the original source into a playable MP4.
steps: Tap Preview real clip on an opportunity
Wait for the render to finish
expected: The returned video is a real rendered segment from the source at the opportunity timestamps.
